query: A modular government datacenter will be constructed and equipped to host shared digital services.
Existing ministry server rooms will be consolidated into two energy-efficient facilities.
The facility will receive redundant power, UPS, precision cooling and fire suppression.
DCIM will monitor capacity, energy use, environmental conditions and incidents.
Certified colocation services will host critical government platforms.
The project will finance the establishment, upgrading and operation of a data centre to host government systems.
